_why: UPD-04 (Phase 36) requires the capability surface and the production CSP block to stay byte-identically zero-diff across the addition of the updater. These are the Phase-35-era (pre-updater) SHA-256 digests of the exact bytes UPD-04 asserts the updater must not perturb. This snapshot is the artifact of record for that assertion — changing a digest here requires an explicit cross-phase decision (e.g. a deliberate, reviewed capability change), never a silent regeneration to make the lint pass. If lint-updater-capability-diff.mjs is failing, the fix is almost always to revert the capability/CSP change, not to update this file.
